:::{#def-flexibility}
#### Flexibility

Let $\candproc{1}$ and $\candproc{2}$ be [fitting procedures](#def-fitting-procedure)
that each choose, by least squares,
a [prediction rule](#def-fitted-model) from a set of candidate [functions](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/functions.html#def-function),
$\candfnset{1}$ and $\candfnset{2}$ respectively.
The procedure $\candproc{2}$ is **at least as flexible** as $\candproc{1}$
if every candidate of $\candproc{1}$ is also a candidate of $\candproc{2}$:

$$
\candfnset{1} \subseteq \candfnset{2}.
$$ {#eq-flexibility}

:::

:::{#rem-source-flexibility}
#### Source: Flexibility

@james2021islr2e [sec. 2.1.3] use flexibility without a formal definition.

:::
